description: brink-desktop main window: core + the folder-picker dialog. File I/O goes through the shell's own guarded commands, not the fs plugin. `core:window:allow-destroy` is not in `core:window:default` (#2370) — the quit path needs it to force-close the window after the awaited save, bypassing another `closeRequested` round-trip. The `brink-cli` sidecar (D3, #2392) is spawned via `Shell::sidecar()`, which never consults this capability's shell scope — that path is gated only by `run_cli`'s own fixed subcommand allowlist (`export-xliff` / `compile-locale` / `regenerate-xliff` / `compile`), so no `shell:allow-execute` grant belongs here.
